text: Even though he didn't become a Muslim, [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] did not accept Islam,
because he didn't want it to be said about him that this person left the religion of his father and his grandfather.
He didn't want that to be said about him after he passed away.
So he defended the Prophet ﷺ and he helped him a lot throughout his period in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]],
from when the Prophet ﷺ proclaimed his messengership in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] up to the end of the Meccan period when [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] died.
[[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] was a great help to the Prophet ﷺ.
